mentions.story: Treat Facebook like something between a telco and a newspaper, says Zuckerberg
mentions.quote: Well, let's put it this way: "The market can stay irrational longer than you can stay solvent." You can stay away from Facebook and then feel really smug ten years from now when it eventually collapses. But until then, you'd have missed out on a lot of important things. The…
